items.text: Broncos RB R.J. Harvey (hamstring), listed questionable vs Jaguars, is unlikely to play per source.
items.opportunity: Increased work for other Broncos RBs.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey (cracked rib) practiced Friday, improved more than anticipated; no WR elevated, pushing to play with optimism he can go vs Raiders barring setback. Schefter notes flak jacket expected if active.
items.why: Practiced Friday; steady improvement; team did not elevate WR.
items.implication: Likely active but monitor for limitations; start if confirmed.
items.opportunity: If OUT, large target bump to Quentin Johnston and Tre Harris (ETR projects 5+ for both contingencies).

items.text: Saints WR Chris Olave (hamstring), listed questionable, is expected to play at Baltimore. Rapoport corroborates along with Chase Young.
items.implication: Start with confidence; full role likely.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers downgraded to OUT for Sunday vs Saints due to hamstring injury.
items.why: Hamstring; unable to finish Week 1 and did not practice sufficiently.
items.implication: Remove from lineups; shifts targets in Ravens passing game.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for remaining WRs and TEs like Mark Andrews.

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins (hamstring) ruled OUT for Sunday vs Bengals.
items.why: Hamstring suffered in practice; missed subsequent days.
items.implication: Sit; look to other Texans pass-catchers and Schultz.
items.opportunity: Target share increase for remaining WRs and Dalton Schultz.

items.text: Rams consider WR Puka Nacua (hip/groin), questionable for MNF vs Giants, a pre-game decision. Missed practice consecutive days; Whittington doubtful (quad).
items.why: Hip injury different from prior psoas; no practice Sat.
items.implication: Have pivot ready for MNF; high upside if active.
items.opportunity: If OUT + Whittington out, heavier TE usage (Ferguson/Parkinson) and bump to Konata Mumpfield or Malachi Fields.

items.text: Raiders elevated TE Chris Myarick with Brock Bowers doubtful (knee/meniscus). Pregame workout possible but unlikely; optimistic for Week 3. Mayer steps up.
items.why: Meniscus trim recovery; limited practice return Friday.
items.implication: Do not start; low chance of play.
items.opportunity: Michael Mayer as TE1; more receiving work possible for Ashton Jeanty as in Week 1.

items.text: Bengals elevated QB Josh Johnson with Joe Burrow questionable (back) but expected to play vs Texans.
items.why: Coach/player comments positive; elevation is contingency.

items.text: Berry on Puka Nacua Q: If misses (esp with Whittington doubtful), heavier TE usage (Ferguson & Parkinson); biggest WR bump to Konata Mumpfield or Malachi Fields. Prepare pivot for MNF.
items.implication: Have flexible lineup plan for MNF.
items.opportunity: TE and secondary WR snaps/routes/targets expand if inactive.

items.text: Steelers downgraded WR Michael Pittman Jr. to OUT for Sunday at Patriots with foot injury.
items.implication: Sit; Roman Wilson/Germie Bernard move up.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/targets for other Steelers WRs.

items.text: ETR Cheap WR Volume: Quentin Johnston and Tre Harris project 5+ targets regardless, with large roles/22%+ shares if Ladd McConkey out in friendly Raiders matchup.
items.why: Week 1 target shares after McConkey exit; volume projections for cheap options.
items.implication: Strong DFS/season-long contingency plays if McConkey limited/out.
items.opportunity: 5+ target floor and expanded snap/route share for QJ/Harris.

items.text: Berry HATES Travis Etienne @ BAL: Matched Kendre Miller rushes Week 1, 69% fantasy pts via air. Kamara expected back squeezes role further; underdog script bad for rushes.
items.why: Reduced Week 1 workload + Kamara return creates committee squeeze.
items.implication: Sit or flex down; prefer other options.
items.conflict: If Kamara limited, Etienne volume rebounds.

items.text: 49ers RB Kaelon Black (groin) expected to play Sunday vs Dolphins after limited week; Shanahan called minor. Schefter confirms expected.
Berry LOVES Kenneth Walker vs IND: 21/24 RB touches through 3Q (74% snaps), 40% routes targeted (team lead). Indy gave up 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry.
items.why: Elite Week 1 utilization + soft run matchup.

items.text: Berry LOVES Ashton Jeanty @ LAC: 99 utilization score (tied Bijan league lead), 19% target share recent, 25+ touches 3 of last 4.
items.why: Elite utilization and receiving involvement; soft Chargers defense.
items.implication: RB1 upside even with Bowers status.

items.text: Berry LOVES Bucky Irving vs CLE: RB9 util, 26% target share, 100% RB RZ touches. CLE allowed 121 rush yds/4.8 YPC.
items.why: Passing-game and goal-line dominance + favorable matchup.

items.text: Berry LOVES Justin Jefferson @ CHI: 37% target share from Wentz Week 1; 93 yds/18 PPG career avg with Wentz. Soft Bears secondary.
items.why: Massive target share with Wentz + historical production + matchup.
items.opportunity: High target volume continues with Wentz.

items.text: Berry LOVES Dak Prescott vs WAS: Home PPG history, WAS torched for 14.5 YPC/3 TDs Week 1; top-5 implied total in high-total game. Smash spot.
